{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVAV-ec8AAAABV_QVDA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BmJKvzg_hrAY", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BmJKv", "number": 10, "title": "Generate consistent multi-view reference sets for text-to-3D", "body": "## Problem

The current text-to-3D flow (#8) generates a single three-quarter concept image before Blender modeling. A single angle leaves the side, back and small features ambiguous, making faithful 3D modeling harder.

We agreed to change **text input** to generate a consistent, structured set of modeling references, while keeping the human-review checkpoints configurable. See #3 for the project vision.

## Goal

Generate a base concept image, then multi-view modeling references from the **same approved/base design**, and pass the **actual image set** to Codex + Blender MCP.

```text
Text input
  → Base concept image
  → Optional human review / regenerate
  → Multi-view reference image set
  → Optional human review / regenerate
  → Codex + Blender MCP models from the images
  → 3D preview / optional review and revisions
  → Export
```

If a review checkpoint is disabled, continue automatically, **but always save and display every generated image afterward**. The existing **image-input** workflow must remain available without mandatory concept generation.

## Reference image specification (v1)

Each image must show the same subject/design, with a simple background, consistent proportions, colors, materials, framing and lighting. Prefer near-orthographic views to reduce perspective distortion. Keep the subject fully visible and avoid unnecessary occlusion.

Use a suitable category/profile for each text project:

### Humanoid / character

**Required full-body views:**
- Front
- Side (clearly labeled left or right)
- Back
- Three-quarter

Use a neutral A-pose (or another consistent modeling-friendly pose) for the full-body set.

**Optional or recommended detail references**, chosen based on the design: face close-up, back/hair, hands, footwear, clothing, equipment and material details. Preserve character identity and outfit across all views.

### Object / prop

**Required whole-object views:**
- Front
- Side
- Back
- Three-quarter

**Optional or recommended detail references** as relevant: top, bottom, close-ups of components, joints/moving parts and material details.

For both categories, preserve the user text as supplementary modeling guidance, including symmetry/asymmetry, dimensions/proportions, materials and hidden parts.

## Requirements

1. **Two-stage image generation.** Keep the existing base concept step. Generate the multi-view set based on that specific design, rather than independently reinventing the object at each angle. Use the user's Codex subscription-backed image-generation capability on the primary path; no separately billed image API or third-party 3D SaaS is required.
2. **Typed, separately accessible artifacts.** Save the base concept and each view as distinct image artifacts with role/view metadata and provenance/parent references. A contact sheet may be added for convenience but must not be the only output.
3. **Model from all required views.** Codex must receive the multi-view images as actual inputs for Blender MCP modeling. Do not merely show the images in the UI or revert to single-image/direct-text modeling silently.
4. **Configurable review checkpoints.** Preserve the existing input, base concept and 3D preview controls; add a distinct optional pause after the multi-view set. When enabled, require explicit human approval before 3D modeling. When disabled, proceed automatically. Pending approvals must survive restart, and changing a setting must not silently clear them.
5. **Review/retry and history.** Display all views in the Web UI, including when generation ran through without pauses. Allow rejecting/regenerating the base concept and regenerating the multi-view set before modeling. Retain past sets, decisions, source concepts and linked model versions.
6. **Consistency check.** Before modeling, have Codex inspect the view set for obvious cross-view contradictions (missing/changed parts, proportion/color/identity mismatches). Report or retry inconsistent views/sets without silently discarding the agreed base design. Keep this pragmatic; an advanced scoring/repair subsystem is not required.
7. **Shared UI/MCP state.** The gen3d MCP interface and Web UI must expose the same reference-set artifacts, statuses, reviews, history and their linkage to derived models.
8. **Replaceable image provider.** Extend the existing small concept-generator abstraction so another image generator could later supply the same typed reference set. Avoid an unnecessary generic provider framework.
9. **Preserve image input and existing features.** Image-to-3D, revisions, version history, GLB/scene export, and local-first execution continue to work.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- A text-input character run produces a base concept plus distinct front/side/back/three-quarter full-body images; an object run produces the analogous four views.
- The full reference set is consistently based on the chosen concept and is passed to Codex as image inputs before Blender modeling; the model records which images were used.
- With multi-view review enabled, 3D modeling cannot begin before explicit UI approval. With it disabled, the workflow continues to 3D and **all intermediate images remain viewable**.
- Reject/regenerate behavior and immutable history work without overwriting previous image sets or models; failed/unavailable image generation blocks the downstream modeling step rather than bypassing the required images.
- HTTP/Web UI and MCP access reflect the same image and review state.
- Existing image-input generation and GLB export still work.
- Add focused automated tests for transition/gating, data persistence, provider substitution, no-bypass and modeling-input wiring. Include actual Codex/Blender validation evidence where supported; distinguish live runs from mock tests and honestly document account/CLI/environment limitations.
- Update README/local setup and workflow documentation to explain both the generated views and checkpoint options. Do not require additional paid APIs.

## Non-goals

Node editor; production-grade automatic image-consistency scoring; full rigging/animation; replacing Blender; unrelated UI redesign.

## References

- #3 — Project vision and goals
- #6 — First end-to-end MVP
- #8 — Concept-image-first workflow and review checkpoints
- README.md

## Required post-merge verification

None by default. Any genuinely necessary post-merge checks should be documented separately.
